propositions: Four LLM code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must transition from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50 respectively) based on code-v3 corpus validation (1760 sidecars, 1173 changes, 4359 findings) with precision >= 0.83.

The packaged criteria_routing.json must be edited to add regression and error-handling as base-reviewer dimension entries (with applies_to=[] and only posture/threshold/blocking_enabled consulted by registry.threshold_for).

Three governance-pin tests (test_impact_model_versioning.py, test_code_review_ws2.py, test_code_review_deletion_impact.py) must be updated to assert the new 7-member approved blocking set (security, secret-detection, high-critical-security, api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling).
The change must land before S1 (dietetic-pompous-boar) captures its immutable CriteriaSnapshot golden baseline to ensure the calibrated thresholds are included in the snapshot.
All existing code-review routing/registry unit tests, lint checks, and typechecks must remain green after the threshold flips.
